abstract: |
  By nature, R/Shiny apps have JavaScript dependencies, most of them being encapsulated by Shiny so that users do 
  not need to worry about them. When they want to extend their applications beyond the baseline, developpers need to inject
  custom JavaScript into the client side, which appears as a *leak* into this encapsulation, especially if the feature
  is delivered through a package.
